Class BlazeBiteTools

public without sharing class BlazeBiteTools

Utility classes for BlazeBite processes including Stripe fee calculations, Firestore field type wrappers for JSON deserialization.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    04/07/2021

Version:
    1.5


Change Log

  • 04/07/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 04/11/2021 - v1.1 - Adds Firestore field types to be used across all deserialization classes.
  • 07/25/2021 - v1.2 - Adds support for Firestore Timestamp fields. StateValidator class: Converts from/to and validates US state names and codes.
  • 03/08/2024 - v1.3 - Add Stripe service fees for international transactions.
  • 10/04/2025 - v1.4 - Overload method calculate() in class StripeFees to allow using custom fees.
  • 03/29/2026 - v1.5 - Class StateValidator and related classes moved to AddressUtils. Update ApexDoc comments to follow standard format. API version updated to 66.0.
